rules.name: Acid Blood
rules.description: If an Alien is wounded, the model that it is engaged with that inflicted the wound takes a ST(X) autohit, where X is the CON value of the model that was wounded. Aliens are immune to Acid Blood.

rules.name: Hive Mind
rules.description: All Aliens gain Fearless (5) and Unbreakable.

rules.name: Lurkers
rules.description:
All Aliens of SZ(2) and below may be deployed as Lurking. This deployment is similar to Stalk, but only a single marker is placed instead of three. This marker may be revealed the same way any standard Stalk marker would be. Squads with more than 20 models may not Lurk.
All Aliens count as having Grappling Hooks (6).

rules.name: Inner Jaw Strike
rules.description: If an enemy is Stunned by the model’s Tail Spike, immediately move the enemy model into B2B and it receives a ST(10) Exploit autohit. If a model cannot be moved to B2B, this is ignored.

rules.name: Egg Pods
rules.description: 1/2/- Trap. Unlike other traps, this is a permanent ‘Egg Pod’ token that has W(1). If an enemy model triggers the trap, immediately make one Close Combat Attack against it using the profile of a Facehugger. If the enemy model is killed, replace it with a friendly Infant model (no Implant roll is needed). The spawned Infant will join the nearest friendly squad.

rules.name: Royal Pheromones
rules.description: RES(2): All models in this squad gain Frenzy.

rules.name: Implant
rules.description: If this model kills an enemy Infantry model in Close Combat, roll a die. On a result of 1-10, the enemy model is turned into an Infant model.

rules.name: Where Did They Go?
rules.description: At the start of it’s activation, if all of the models are unengaged and have no character attached, this squad may Recall. It may be redeployed as normal next turn.

characteristics.name: RULES
characteristics.$text: Armour-Piercing(4), Critical Force(3), Slow to Reload

rules.name: Bulletproof
rules.description: This model has A(+6) against Type (A/HG/H) Ranged attack hits its front arc.

rules.name: Headlong Ram
rules.description: RES(2): As part of a Run action, the Crusher moves directly forward its full movement allowance; it may not turn. Any model that would come into B2B with this model’s front arc takes a ST(13) autohit and is moved out of its path by the shortest route possible. This model may move through walls as long as there is space to place the model on the other side of the wall. Any structure punched through loses W(1). If the Crusher comes into contact with Impassible Terrain or a model SZ(3) or higher, it’s forward movement is stopped in B2B with that object.

characteristics.name: RULES
characteristics.$text: Armour-Piercing(4), Critical Force(3), Slow to Reload

rules.name: Feast
rules.description: RES(2): If this model kills any enemy models in CC, it may make a Regeneration test at the end of its activation.

rules.name: Shockwave
rules.description: RES(2): All enemy models within 3” must make a CON test. If they fail, they are pinned.

rules.name: Paired Weapons(ML/F)
rules.description: Paired Weapons (X) - The model can use up to two of its equipped weapons of the (X) type in the same action. In ranged combat, both weapons have the same primary target. (X) can be a specific weapon, e.g. (combat knife), or a weapon type, e.g. (HG) or (CC).

rules.name: Boost(1/2)
rules.description: Boost (X/Y): RES (X): The model gains SP(+Y).

characteristics.name: RULES
characteristics.$text: Armour-Piercing(5), Concussive(2), Critical Force(2), Deadly, Inner Jaw Strike RES(1): Sweep, Slow to Reload; Lose Critical Force(2) and Inner Jaw Strike

rules.name: Leader(2/Royal Guard)
rules.description: Leader (X/Y) – If this model is your commander, you may take (X) of squad (Y) as Troop types. All other limitations remain.

rules.name: Leader(1/Royal Guard)
rules.description: Leader (X/Y) – If this model is your commander, you may take (X) of squad (Y) as Troop types. All other limitations remain.
